_doc: Adapter contracts. A skill performs an OPERATION (slot.op); the user's connectors.json maps each op to a real tool. 'safety': read = no side effects; write = changes the user's data (confirm bulk or overwriting writes); spend = costs credits or money (approve each time); send = reaches another person (draft first, explicit approval each time). An unmapped op uses the slot's fallback and says so once.

find_contacts.out: contacts[{id, name, org, email, phone, tags, last_touch}]

find_by_buy_box.out: contacts whose recorded buy box fits, with the note or field that shows it. If the CRM has no buy-box field, search notes/tags and say that matches are inferred.

get_history.out: notes, calls, emails, deals, newest first

set_stage.out: ok. Stages used by this plugin: lead, pitched, bov_sent, listing_signed, on_market, under_contract, closed, lost; map to the CRM's own stage names.

upsert_contact.out: contact id. Dedupe on email; never overwrite a non-empty field without showing the diff and getting a yes.

crm.records: Buy box, last contact and stage must live somewhere; the mapping's `notes` says where (custom field, tag, note prefix).

draft.out: draft id/link. Drafts only; this is the default for outbound.

send.out: sent id. Explicit approval for each message.

find_people.in: role, company, geography, or owner entity
find_people.out: people with sourced email/phone where the tool has them

enrich.out: emails/phones. Costs credits: state the estimate and get approval first.

contact-data.records: Individual owners' phones are not in public record; only enrichment tools can supply them. Cite which source gave each contact detail.

draft_campaign.out: draft or saved campaign, not started

add_to_sequence.out: enrolled count. Reaches people: explicit approval of the exact list and message each time.

create_event.out: event link. Default no invitations sent; inviting others is a send.

send_for_signature.out: envelope id. Explicit approval each time.

post.out: message link. Explicit approval each time.
